subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘TEACHER is written as ‘2513859’ and 'PRESS' is written as ‘7951010’. How will ‘ZYGOTES’ be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cbc5c097aeb98a48b72ad50b9d4e29b952906e3f76fa5d128ba82d4b9289f2b.png] ​
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The alphabets with 2 digit positional values are coded as sum of the digits and the alphabets with 1 digit positional value are coded as it is.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4bec5fbc3e76d789849a8991fd0ea124712cf57ef6fcddd4061d2dd78604872.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41eb7136b235e43db8d6e11334e754b6c89278e9f32781d847bfccdcde55d144.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b552ad999e60c6c006d70b64b030cd72d02ec085dca210e9b1ce2f51c5c8fec1.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
